notFound.label: Error 404
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The address you tried to open does not exist or was moved.

forbidden.label: Error 403 · restricted access
forbidden.title: You do not have access to this area
forbidden.text: Your profile is not allowed to see this content. If you think this is a mistake, contact the coordination office.

server.label: Server error
server.title: Something went wrong on our side
server.text: The server could not complete the request. Try again in a few moments.

offline.label: No connection
offline.title: You are offline
offline.text: Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data. We will reload the page as soon as the connection is back.

unexpected.label: Unexpected error
unexpected.title: Something went wrong on this page
unexpected.text: Could not display this screen right now. You can reload or go back to start.
